name: CalMac ferries (Clyde and Hebrides), commercial vehicles
law: CalMac's commercial vehicle single rates from 2026-03-27 (until further notice): per route, its fixed base rate (Coll–Tiree, Tiree–Castlebay, Uig's and Ullapool's routes) plus its price per 0.5 m of the vehicle's length, for each started 0.5 m and 6 m at least, one way; vehicles over 3.5 t (the route fare pages: commercial vehicles are charged by length in 0.5 metre increments, and the fares exclude VAT, which is left out here too). Length groups to 25.5 m. The table is an image, read by OCR: each route's base and price per 0.5 m give its fares from 6 to 17 m as printed. The ports are OpenStreetMap's ferry terminals, priced where a route goes out on OpenStreetMap's car ferry line from them; routes sharing a line (a ship calling on the way) are one system, priced from the first port passed to the last. Wide loads (dearer) aren't priced. Castlebay–Lochboisdale: no car ferry line between them in OpenStreetMap, not priced. Fionnphort–Iona: motor vehicles only with a permit there (OpenStreetMap), not priced. Mallaig–Canna: no car ferry line between them in OpenStreetMap, not priced. Mallaig–Eigg: motor vehicles only with a permit there (OpenStreetMap), not priced. Mallaig–Muck: Muck not found in OpenStreetMap, not priced. Mallaig–Rum: no car ferry line between them in OpenStreetMap, not priced.
